_about: The Create home's news wall (lib/front-page.ts reads this; docs/tasks/task-create-front-page.md). One entry per tile, newest first. type: model | effect | trending | update. size: big | wide | tall | medium | small. media: a key in public/showcase/manifest.json. action: one of {fill: text put in the box, never sent} {href: a studio page} {effect: an effects tab} {look: a free look id} {talk: true, the talking-photo card}. accent: the words in the title lit in the tag's colour. requires: a capability that must be true (an entry for a parked model hides). peek: also rotates in the tab behind the box. No offers until one is live (Mike, 2026-10-22). Trending entries are picked by hand: the week's real usage is per account and may not be shown across accounts.
